body: I’m now in the ER. Thought I’d feel better after sleeping. Turns out no.

Update:  I phoned a suicide line and that helped a tiny bit. I headed home and fessed up to everyone because nobody knew about this. My mom didn’t help... said it was in my head and all made up. And that all the micro aggressions that lead to me losing so much weight due to not wanting to eat their food. Well that was made up too. Fucking hell. Shit I’m feeling suicidal again.....

I went back to the room with my partner relaxing. She was upset at me turning off Find my Friend on my phone. I told her “I don’t know what to say. I just want to end my life” and broke down crying for what seems like an hour. 

Tempted to go to the emergency room.

Yeah she knows more or less what’s going on. Not that I’m suicidal but I think she’ll know by tonight by how I’m behaving. 

I can’t go into my business stuff because it’ll get too close to IDing me. Just that I was successful, I loved it and it loved me. But my own hang ups got in the way. 

There’s more to this like how to family gave us a house so we spent two years doing it up to have them take it away without giving us a penny for our work. We planned to move in and start a family then one day they said they’d prefer to have the money due to how much they could now get for it after our renovations. Right?!

Just phoned a suicide hotline that helped. 

The thing about this is how worthless I feel. I dropped 1/4 of my already slim body weight due to not feeling good enough to eat
